assessment_scope: Formal, independent first-pass Design Review of the sole affected model, validation at docs/design/engineering/validation.md, including its inline source-composition graph, illustrative Python excerpt, Node authoring guidance and scenario table. The assessment covers the complete living model and its interactions with System, Engineering, product proof owners, Assessment, Authoring/Plan, contributor navigation, portable guidance and prior work. Upstream authority is the current proposal-review record for the unchanged accepted proposal. This is approval of the exact Design package for authorized delivery planning, not a repeated proposal-only direction assessment.
independence_basis: The complete Validation Design revision was authored by /root, recorded as codex-root/design. Separate agent /root/proposal_reviewer performs this fresh Design assessment as design-reviewer/review. This reviewer previously assessed the proposal but did not author or edit the proposal, the Validation Design, its inline examples or the author's decision/evidence. The reviewer read the full 694-line model, inspected the actual diff and the selected upstream and interaction basis, and independently chose this judgment. The author supplied the handoff and storage context, not the review result.
limitations: This judgment approves only the exact Design package for authorized delivery planning. It does not authorize implementation, approve a delivery allocation, establish actual suite reorganization, or claim final verification, branch/PR readiness or publication authority.

The complete current case inventory, concrete group dispositions, source moves, exact helper interfaces and migration commands must be established and independently assessed through Delivery and implementation. Their absence at this Design boundary is explicit rather than treated as completed work.

The Python code and Node instructions are illustrative and were assessed semantically with targeted implementation checks; the omitted helper implementations were not executed as a new test fixture. Existing author-recorded checks were inspected without rerunning full runtime suites, and their results are relied on only within their recorded structural/selected-check scope.

Older completed migrations and overlapping initiatives retain their original evidence scope. This review does not retrospectively approve their implementations or remove the need to reconcile actual current sources and added/generated populations before this initiative can close.
rationale: Accepted direction and required behavior are preserved. TEST-SR-19 makes behavior modules, support and collection explicit while allowing small cohesive responsibilities to share a module; TEST-SR-20 makes conditions, action, expected outcomes, fresh fixture ownership and meaningful parameter observations assessable; VAL-SR-32 retains the complete repository/package inventory and final reconciliation. Existing TEST-SR-01–18 and VAL-SR obligations remain intact. The Design does not narrow all-tests assessment into a Skill-only pilot or require needless rewriting of suitable groups.

Technical realization is coherent. The responsibility table, dependency graph and prose assign ordinary collection to entrypoints, scenarios to behavior groups, fresh data to factories, resource ownership/cleanup to lifecycle helpers and independent invariants to assertion helpers. Direct Python TestCase subclasses and native Node functions remain compatible with the existing execution system. Composition is the default; justified mixins or shared contract groups require explicit consumers, hook ownership and discovery evidence. The rules prevent circular support imports and production dependence on test-only helpers without mandating a new utilities layer or framework.

Scenario and oracle requirements are sufficient. The Design preserves defining faults in the case, independent expected results, actual observation boundaries, meaningful rejection diagnostics and required absence of side effects. It addresses nested mutable defaults, early cleanup registration, process-global isolation, immutable prepared inputs, relevant environment/working-directory values, generated-case registration, meaningful parameter names and the distinction between Python subtests and independently scheduled methods. These rules refine the existing criteria instead of replacing real CLI/archive/filesystem observations with convenient mocks.

Compatibility and discovery constraints are explicit. Current aggregate entrypoints and package-native selectors remain supported until coherent migration; hyphenated entrypoints are not assumed discoverable through generic filesystem discovery. A changed case identity requires before/after mapping and consumer reconciliation, while duplicate aliases cannot preserve a count by executing twice. Actual implementation inspection confirmed that the current Python adapter uses the normal unittest entrypoint and addressable Class.test_method IDs, and the Node collector checks named populations and rejects zero or duplicate identities. The Design's abstraction is feasible against that current machinery.

Full-scope migration and recovery are adequate for Delivery. Complete suite organization covers Skill, Validation, Packaging, Release, package-native tests and reached fixtures/helpers/generated/imported populations outside obvious roots. Source/caller inspection and ordinary discovery jointly establish scope; group-level disposition records obligations, protected failures, boundaries, members, generated families and consumers. Unknown contribution remains preserved and blocks affected completion. The Design requires final additions/removals reconciliation, intended negative detection, correct rerun commands and restoration or correction of a failed source/fixture/consumer slice.

Existing behavior and authority owners remain distinct. System and Engineering continue to own capability layout and tooling placement; Validation owns the detailed test-source method. Product owners retain command, transaction, archive, installation, candidate and publication observations. Assessment retains independence, evidence applicability and closeout; Plan retains concrete milestone and integrated verification allocation. No runtime identity, schema, worker budget, permission, new product retirement or public release policy is changed by this package.

Consumer dispositions are justified. CONTRIBUTING already links to Validation's organization contract, and any navigation/source-consumer updates are explicitly assigned to the affected implementation slices. Inspection of templates/shared/test-quality.md and test-maintenance.md confirmed existing independent-oracle, observation-boundary, discovery, caller and protection-preserving maintenance guidance. The newly selected concrete Python/Node structure is repository contributor guidance, so no new portable customer requirement or packaged resource is required. An actual later consumer conflict must return to its canonical owner rather than be ignored.

Architecture views agree. The overview retains the five Validation responsibilities and labeled external contract, Delivery and Assessment relationships; Criteria resolves to the new test-source section. The source-composition graph elaborates the necessary Building Block view with owned behavior/support dependencies. Context, Building Block, Runtime and Deployment each have an explicit necessity decision and a corresponding diagram. Unchanged scheduling, process and trust boundaries justify retaining their runtime/deployment realization; no separate deployed test-organization service is implied.

VAL-DEC-11 records the selected approach with alternatives and consequences. It explains why deeper inheritance, a new framework, pure file splitting, wholesale rewrites and fixed quotas do not establish the selected quality outcome. It permits small local duplication when clearer and leaves exact migration/verification allocation with Delivery. Earlier decisions retain their identities and original scopes. The changed text updates the stale scripts/test-*.py migration description to the current capability roots without retiring current entrypoints.

Inline examples have proper scope and meaningful failure observations. The Python excerpt explicitly omits imports/helpers, assumes a private valid declared resource, invokes the real boundary, checks the intended rejection and limits its final assertion to absence of a recreated file. The diagnostic fragment matches scripts/lib/validation/skill_validation.py and the command emits validation errors on stderr. The text correctly requires a broader before/after comparison for any general no-writes claim. Node guidance and the scenario contrasts preserve resource cleanup, named registration, fresh state, record-byte preservation, independent archive inventories and self-contained recovery. These illustrative examples do not claim executable-product evidence.

Representative local and integrated acceptance intent is sufficient. The extended boundary table and combined hazards cover unapplied fixture faults, same-logic oracles, setup failure cleanup, inherited/generated discovery loss, helper extraction plus isolation/oracle failure, case renaming plus stale callers, preserved negative detection and complete final inventory reconciliation. Delivery can derive concrete proof and recovery from those outcomes without an exhaustive per-function catalogue or a new semantic gate. Independent whole-change Code Review and distinct Verify remain required at later closeout.

Evidence and prior-work reliance remain bounded. The current proposal-review approves the unchanged proposal and has no findings; this new Design receives its own complete assessment. The author decision identifies the sole member and inline examples, prior model identity and unchanged interactions. The design-validation record names successful structural, prose, whitespace and selected CI commands against this exact model, with explicit limits. Those mechanical results support validity and existing-machinery compatibility but are not treated as semantic approval or proof of completed reorganization. Relevant prior organization, risk-driven pilot and skill-refinement plan scopes were inspected; the new Design explicitly requires current-implementation reconciliation without rewriting or borrowing their historical judgments.
summary: The complete Design package coherently translates the accepted direction into actionable test-source responsibilities, scenario and fixture rules, representative acceptance outcomes and a complete-inventory preservation boundary. It is sufficient for authorized delivery planning.
